# Focused handoff to Root

Implementation scope is `services/continuous-monitoring/` only. There is no shared navigation, `site.ts`, homepage, localized homepage, `commerce.astro`, gateway, DNS or production change. No public deployment or price claim has been made.

The existing offer describes a proposed $99–$999/month service and broader drift coverage. This branch supplies finite safe HTTP availability/body/status observation, selected public JSON declaration fields, the existing Observatory projection, durable schedules, immutable diffs and polling delivery. It does not supply billing automation, authenticated or paid probes, arbitrary TLS/domain inventory, automatic release control, email or push callbacks. Root must make the public offer match the deployed coverage; the old price is a hypothesis, and this code does not validate economics.

The dedicated API's manifest is available at `/v1/manifest`; its checked-in `deploymentState` is `feature-branch-not-deployed`. Root can expose this contract through a reviewed dedicated route or subdomain on existing infrastructure after deployment acceptance. No gateway edit is part of this patch. The OpenAPI document is in this directory; serve it from the reviewed deployment's documentation location. Health, monitoring and poll traffic must reach the actual service, not a static demo or test endpoint.

Review preview for a future dedicated service entry, only after deployment:

> Watch selected public routes and JSON declarations on a finite schedule. Inspect the original baseline, factual changes and usage; consume and acknowledge alerts through an authenticated API inbox. Free local demo available. Paid subscriptions require an explicitly provisioned entitlement.

This preview is documentation, not an approved live claim. It must be adjusted to actual deployment and subscription integration evidence. Existing homepage style and copy should remain as restored. Any public human-facing copy/navigation/offer change requires the operator's focused review under the owning `AGENTS.md`; this requirement does not gate the authorized feature-branch commit/push.

Root's remaining actions: review and integrate the named feature branch; choose and validate existing Linux service paths and persistent disk; configure private tenant credentials and finite entitlements; install the reviewed supervisor/timer or cron recipe and dedicated ingress; prove a changed public source reaches a real API consumer; record production run metrics and billing-seam status; review any public-facing diff before publication. Production cost, margin, demand, queue capacity and cadence guarantees remain unknown until measured.
